subject.title: refactor(qa): retire the standalone Matrix QA runtime

question: Should maintainers accept this PR's qa-matrix package deletion, reusable Matrix QA workflow secret boundary, and additive QA runner adapter contract after the small Markdown repair?
rationale: Those are dependency ownership, release automation, security-boundary, and plugin SDK compatibility decisions that ClawSweeper cannot settle from source inspection alone.

options.title: Repair and approve exact head
options.body: Fix the AGENTS Markdown indentation, then require authorized dependency, workflow/security, and SDK-surface approval on the reviewed head before merge.

options.title: Split risky surfaces
options.body: Move either the reusable workflow routing or the QA runner adapter hook into a smaller owner-reviewed follow-up if maintainers want a narrower retirement diff.

options.title: Pause the draft
options.body: Keep the PR draft until maintainers are ready to own the package deletion and release QA workflow change together.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve exact head
recommendation.body: Fix the AGENTS Markdown indentation, then require authorized dependency, workflow/security, and SDK-surface approval on the reviewed head before merge.
